title: Canonical Loop Closure Payload (P3)
description: Backend-independent loop-closure payload stored in CAS. Contains candidate detections and accepted/rejected closures. A loop closure is an observation/constraint (D-LC-01), not a direct pose mutation. Both accepted and rejected closures are persisted for audit (D-LC-05). The metadata row in MetadataDb stores aggregate information; this payload stores the detailed candidate and closure records.

candidates.description: Potential matches between frame pairs, before geometric verification (D-LC-02, D-LC-03). Candidates are lightweight and may be numerous. Persisted for audit and re-evaluation.

closures.description: Verified loop closures — accepted or rejected (D-LC-05). Both are persisted for provenance and audit.

LoopClosureCandidate.description: A potential match between two frames before geometric verification (D-LC-02). Candidates are generated by feature matching (e.g. bag-of-words, NetVLAD) and are numerous.

trajectory_id.description: The trajectory these candidate frames belong to.

source_frame_id.description: UUID referencing the newer frame (the frame doing the revisiting).

target_frame_id.description: UUID referencing the older frame (the previously observed location).

feature_match_score.description: Raw matching score from the feature matcher. Backend-specific, non-negative.

matcher.description: Which matcher produced this candidate (e.g. 'bow', 'netvlad', 'superglue'). Backend-specific.

created_at_ns.description: Creation timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

LoopClosure.description: A verified loop closure — an accepted or rejected pose constraint (D-LC-05, D-LC-06). Accepted closures produce PoseGraph edges. Rejected closures are retained for provenance.

trajectory_id.description: The trajectory this closure belongs to.

candidate_id.description: Optional back-reference to the LoopClosureCandidate that produced this closure.

source_frame_id.description: UUID referencing the newer frame (source of the constraint).

target_frame_id.description: UUID referencing the older frame (target of the constraint).

status.description: Verification outcome (D-LC-05). Both statuses are persisted for audit.

inlier_ratio.description: Fraction of geometrically consistent feature matches after verification.

inlier_count.description: Absolute number of geometrically consistent inliers.

temporal_separation_ns.description: |timestamp_source - timestamp_target| in nanoseconds (D-LC-06). Small values suggest consecutive frames, not a true loop.

spatial_separation_m.description: Euclidean distance between original poses in meters (D-LC-06). Very large values may indicate false positives.

created_at_ns.description: Creation timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.
